The '''IR-89 Armored Assault Droid''' was a model of three-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]], a freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. IR-89 Armored Assault Droids were among the forces that defended the Shroud's factory on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
IR-89 Armored Assault Droids appear as enemies in the final [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] mission&mdash;"The Shroud Revealed" for Republic players and "All the Pieces" for Imperials&mdash; in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
